description: Single source of truth for per-model list prices used by hooks/subagent-usage.sh to price measured token usage, and referenced (not restated) by README.md and pipeline-orchestrator/SKILL.md. Prices are USD per million tokens. cache_write_multiplier and cache_read_multiplier scale the input price for cache_creation_input_tokens and cache_read_input_tokens respectively. `match` is evaluated top to bottom against the lowercased model id from the transcript; the first regex hit selects the tier. A model id that matches nothing is priced as null and flagged with pricing_note so a confident wrong number is never written.
_comment: Per-MTok prices, verified against platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing on 2026-09-20. Tier aliases map the model ID a dispatch actually ran on (match[], FIRST hit wins, so specific patterns precede generic ones). Sonnet 5 sits at 2/10: the launch introductory rate became the standard price and the scheduled increase to 3/15 was cancelled. Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 read cache at 0.025x, every other tier at 0.1x.
